up: Retrieve the distinct canonical SMILES for all compounds tested against the human adenosine A2A receptor. Filter the target_dictionary table where pref_name = 'Adenosine A2A receptor' and organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Join activities to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno. Return only the distinct canonical_smiles values. Do not apply any row limits or additional filters.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles
FROM assays a
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.pref_name = 'Adenosine A2A receptor'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
